writeup.title: feat(reviews): add customer flag moderation and admin hidden review list
writeup.summary: Adds review moderation capabilities allowing customers to flag reviews with specific reasons. When a review receives three flags, its status is automatically changed to hidden. Admins can view a paginated list of hidden reviews.
changes: Added a review_flags table and a status field to reviews via migration 0004.
Added POST /reviews/<id>/flag endpoint for customers to report reviews.
Added GET /reviews/hidden endpoint for administrators to list reviews hidden by flags.
Updated public review listings and rating summaries to exclude hidden reviews.

functions.what_it_does: Flags a review by ID with a given reason and returns its updated status and flag count.
Lists paginated reviews hidden by flags for authenticated administrators.
Returns a select query for published reviews of a product ordered newest first.
Calculates the average rating and review count for published reviews of a product.
Records a review flag from a user, hiding the review if the flag count reaches the threshold.
Returns a select query for hidden reviews ordered by ID.
Placeholder function for review text moderation scoring.

writeup.release_note: Customers can flag reviews (POST /reviews/<id>/flag). Three flags hide a review; admins list hidden reviews at GET /reviews/hidden.
